template.title: The Balloon and the Lost Toy
template.summary: A child learns kindness by finding a lost toy and sharing it with a new friend.

sentences.text_with_blanks: [[slot_child]] loved to play with [[slot_toy]] in the bright [[slot_place]].
One sunny day, the [[slot_toy]] rolled away into a big, [[slot_color]] balloon.
The balloon floated up, like a lazy kite, and the toy was lost.
She felt a little sad and thought, 'Maybe I should just walk home.'
But then she remembered her promise to be kind, so she took a deep breath.
She called out, 'Hello? Is anyone here?' and a friendly [[slot_friend]] answered.
The [[slot_friend]] asked, 'Do you want to play?' and together they looked for the toy.
They found the toy hidden under the balloon, sparkling like a tiny star.
They shared the toy, and [[slot_child]] gave the [[slot_friend]] a tasty [[slot_food]].
They laughed and played [[slot_activity]] until the sun set, feeling happy and brave.
